cues.en: Derivatives of polynomials are fun and easy to compute.
cues.zh: 多項式的導數很好玩，也很容易算。

cues.en: There's a simple rule that you apply, and in this video you're going to learn that rule.
cues.zh: 只需要套用簡單的法則，這支影片就會學到。

cues.en: And I'm actually going to start just by teaching you the rule.
cues.zh: 我會直接從教你法則開始。

cues.en: So this rule applies for any polynomial of any order.
cues.zh: 這個法則適用於任何次數的多項式。

cues.en: And the rule is that you take the exponent here in R and you put it in front of the coefficient here.
cues.zh: 做法是，把這裡的指數 r 拿下來，放到係數前面。

cues.en: So c is just some coefficient, R is the exponent.
cues.zh: c 只是某個係數，r 是指數。

cues.en: Multiply the coefficient, you don't change the coefficient any subtract one from the exponent and that's it.
cues.zh: 乘上係數，原係數不變，再把指數減 1，就這樣。

cues.en: Pretty simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: So the exponent comes down as a coefficient multiplies any existing coefficient and the exponent gets subtracted by one.
cues.zh: 所以指數降下來作為係數，乘上原有係數，而指數減去 1。

cues.en: Now you already saw an example of this with x squared a few videos ago, so the derivative of x squared
cues.zh: 前幾支影片，你已經從 x 平方看過一個例子。所以 x 平方的導數

cues.en: is two x, which is really x to the power of two.
cues.zh: 是 2x，而 x 平方其實是 x 的二次方。

cues.en: So this two comes down as a multiplicative constant and the exponent here becomes two minus one, which is one.
cues.zh: 這個 2 降下來，成為相乘常數，指數則變成 2 減 1，也就是 1。

cues.en: So two x to the power of one.
cues.zh: 所以是 2x 的一次方。

cues.en: And of course we just leave out that one.
cues.zh: 當然，這個 1 直接省略。

cues.en: All right, a few more examples on this slide.
cues.zh: 好，這張投影片還有幾個例子。

cues.en: Here is a fourth order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這裡是四次多項式。

cues.en: So pause the video and compute the derivative of this function.
cues.zh: 暫停影片，計算這個函數的導數。

cues.en: All right, so the derivative of three times x to the power of four is 12 x cubed.
cues.zh: 好，3x 的四次方，導數是 12x 三次方。

cues.en: And why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, you bring down the four, it multiplies the three to give us 12.
cues.zh: 把 4 拿下來，乘上 3，得到 12。

cues.en: And then this three here in the exponent comes from four minus one.
cues.zh: 而指數這裡的 3，來自 4 減 1。

cues.en: Okay, so this is for one term a polynomial function with one term.
cues.zh: 好，這是一項、只有一項的多項式函數。

cues.en: A polynomial with multiple terms is exactly the same because you already know that the derivative is linear.
cues.zh: 多項的多項式完全相同，因為你已經知道微分是線性的。

cues.en: So to compute the derivative of this really long function, you just compute the derivative of each piece separately and then add them together as appropriate or subtract in this case.
cues.zh: 所以計算這個很長的函數之導數，只要分別對每部分求導數，再適當相加，或在這裡相減。

cues.en: All right, So pause the video, have a go at this one.
cues.zh: 好，暫停影片，試試這題。

cues.en: And did you figure it out yet?
cues.zh: 想出來了嗎？

cues.en: So here is the answer.
cues.zh: 這是答案。

cues.en: Now, most of these terms are pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 大部分項都相當直接。

cues.en: I want to say a few quick words about this one here.
cues.zh: 我想簡單談談這一項，

cues.en: This number one, this comes from the derivative of x.
cues.zh: 這個 1，來自 x 的導數。

cues.en: Now there's secretly a one in the exponent over here, but of course, it's left out by convention.
cues.zh: 這裡的指數其實藏著 1，只是慣例省略。

cues.en: So when you compute the derivative of x, you bring down the one.
cues.zh: 所以對 x 求導數，把 1 拿下來。

cues.en: So that's where this one comes from.
cues.zh: 這個 1 就是這樣來的。

cues.en: And then you take for the exponent one minus one, which is x to the power of zero, which is just one.
cues.zh: 再把指數 1 減 1，得到 x 的零次方，也就是 1。

cues.en: So then we leave it out.
cues.zh: 所以把它省略。

cues.en: And here for this term here, this zero comes from ten, the derivative of ten.
cues.zh: 這一項的零，來自 10，也就是 10 的導數。

cues.en: And remember that the derivative of a constant is zero, because the function of a constant is just a flat line and well, it never changes.
cues.zh: 記得，常數導數為零，因為常數函數只是水平線，從來不變。

cues.en: So the derivative is always zero.
cues.zh: 所以導數永遠是零。

cues.en: So basically, whenever you compute the derivative of polynomials, when you get to the intercept term or the constant term, it's just ignored.
cues.zh: 基本上，每當求多項式的導數，遇到截距項、常數項，就直接忽略。

cues.en: You just leave it out.
cues.zh: 直接不寫。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I want to warn you that you need to know more rules for when there are composite functions or the product of functions.
cues.zh: 不過提醒你，如果有合成函數或函數的乘積，還需要更多法則。

cues.en: These two functions, for example, you need to know something called the product rule and something called the chain rule.
cues.zh: 例如這兩個函數，需要知道乘法法則與鏈鎖律，

cues.en: In order to differentiate these two functions, you will learn about those rules in the next section.
cues.zh: 才能對它們微分。下一節會學這些法則。

cues.en: I just want to give you a heads up that the rule for derivatives of polynomials is so simple only when the function is just a polynomial.
cues.zh: 我只是先提醒，多項式導數的法則這麼簡單，前提是函數就只是多項式。

cues.en: In fact, this is one of the reasons why polynomials are so great to work with in math and why they're so useful in applications.
cues.zh: 其實這也是數學裡多項式很好處理、應用上非常有用的原因之一。

cues.en: Their derivative is really easy and really fast to compute, so you're going to have to wait a little bit more in the course before learning how to differentiate functions like this.
cues.zh: 它們的導數很容易、很快就能算出。所以要學怎麼微分這樣的函數，還得在課程裡再等一下。

cues.en: Okay, Here you see two more examples.
cues.zh: 好，這裡再看兩個例子。

cues.en: I would like you to pause the video, compute the derivatives of these two functions, and then come back to the to the video for the answers.
cues.zh: 請暫停影片，計算這兩個函數的導數，再回來看答案。

cues.en: All right, Here they are.
cues.zh: 好，答案在這裡。

cues.en: I won't go through these in detail.
cues.zh: 我不會詳細講。

cues.en: You can pause the video if you need more time to check your work.
cues.zh: 如果需要更多時間核對，可以暫停影片。

cues.en: But I do want to point out quickly that the E to the pi and pi to the E term here are just constants.
cues.zh: 不過我想快速指出，這裡 e 的 π 次方，以及 π 的 e 次方，都只是常數。

cues.en: There's nothing weird about them.
cues.zh: 沒什麼奇怪的。

cues.en: They look kind of funny.
cues.zh: 看起來有點怪。

cues.en: They're a little unusual looking, but they do not involve X.
cues.zh: 有點不尋常，但不包含 x。

cues.en: This is not E to the x or x to the PI or anything like that.
cues.zh: 這不是 e 的 x 次方，或 x 的 π 次方之類的。

cues.en: These terms do not involve x, so they are just numbers.
cues.zh: 這些項沒有 x，所以只是數字。

cues.en: They are just constants.
cues.zh: 都只是常數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I want to go through one more example where we are going to use the limits formula of the derivative to compute the derivative of this function here.
cues.zh: 我想再做一個例子，用導數的極限公式，計算這個函數的導數。

cues.en: So here's our function to x to the power of three.
cues.zh: 函數是 2x 三次方。

cues.en: And here I'm helping you get started a little bit.
cues.zh: 這裡我先幫你起個頭。

cues.en: So this is the limits definition of the derivative.
cues.zh: 這是導數的極限定義。

cues.en: And what I have done here is.
cues.zh: 我在這裡，

cues.en: Written out F of X plus h, so two x cubed.
cues.zh: 寫出 f(x+h)，所以是 2x 三次方，

cues.en: And then in place of x we write x plus h minus f of x over h, and then the limit as h goes to zero.
cues.zh: 但把 x 換成 x+h，再減 f(x)，除以 h，取 h 趨近零時的極限。

cues.en: This is the limits definition of the derivative.
cues.zh: 這就是導數的極限定義。

cues.en: So now I want you to pause the video and work through this computation on your own and see how far you get.
cues.zh: 現在請暫停影片，自己算算，看看能做到哪裡。

cues.en: And now I'm going to walk you through the solution here.
cues.zh: 接著我帶你看解法。

cues.en: So to get started, we actually just multiply out these terms here.
cues.zh: 首先，把這些項乘開。

cues.en: So I've written that out three times x plus h times x plus h, times x plus h, and then we just have to start multiplying and expanding all of these terms.
cues.zh: 我寫成三個相乘，(x+h)(x+h)(x+h)，接著開始相乘、展開所有項。

cues.en: I've done that here in a couple of steps.
cues.zh: 這裡分成幾步。

cues.en: First, just multiplying these first two terms and then I'm going to multiply by this third X plus H here.
cues.zh: 先乘前兩項，再乘第三個 x+h。

cues.en: It's getting rather long and then we have to multiply through by two and then it's starting to get even longer.
cues.zh: 式子變得很長，接著全部乘 2，又開始變得更長。

cues.en: But it isn't so bad.
cues.zh: 不過也沒那麼糟。

cues.en: Now, once you expand all of these terms as far as you can, as much as they will expand, then what you should start doing is looking for terms that will cancel.
cues.zh: 當你把所有項盡可能完全展開，就應該開始找可以消掉的項。

cues.en: In this particular example, you'll see there's a2x cubed and a minus two x cubed.
cues.zh: 這個例子，可以看到有 2x³ 和負 2x³。

cues.en: So those two terms cancel and then the next step is to try to group as many of the H's together as possible in the numerator.
cues.zh: 它們抵消，下一步是把分子裡的 h 盡可能整理在一起。

cues.en: Hopefully you will be able to cancel out some H's in the numerator and of course in the denominator.
cues.zh: 希望能和分母的 h 約掉。

cues.en: So we won't have this problem here of H going to zero.
cues.zh: 這樣就不會有 h 趨近零造成的問題。

cues.en: And then actually is the case, we can you can see that there is at least one H in every term here once we cancel out this term and this first term.
cues.zh: 其實確實如此，消掉這項和第一項後，這裡每一項至少都有一個 h。

cues.en: And so that means that this H and this H will cancel each other out and that gives us our final conclusion
cues.zh: 所以這個 h 和這個 h 能約掉，得到最後的結論，

cues.en: of the limit as H goes to zero of six X squared and this six X squared comes from the addition of these
cues.zh: 也就是 h 趨近零時，6x² 的極限。而這個 6x²，來自這

cues.en: two terms, two X squared and four X squared.
cues.zh: 兩項相加，2x² 和 4x²。

cues.en: And then here we have H times something else.
cues.zh: 接著這裡有 h 乘上其他內容。

cues.en: And now because this function is continuous, we don't have to worry about any discontinuities.
cues.zh: 因為這個函數連續，不必擔心不連續。

cues.en: When H goes to zero, we can use the plug in method.
cues.zh: h 趨近零時，可以用代入法。

cues.en: This whole term goes to zero and that leaves us with the limit.
cues.zh: 這整項會變成零，剩下這個極限。

cues.en: As h goes to zero of this function here is six x squared, which follows exactly the same rule that I showed in the beginning of this video.
cues.zh: h 趨近零時，這個函數的極限是 6x²，完全符合影片開頭展示的法則。

cues.en: And that rule is actually called the power rule.
cues.zh: 那個法則其實叫作冪次法則。

cues.en: It's one of several rules of differentiation that you will learn about in much more detail in the next section of the course.
cues.zh: 它是好幾個微分法則之一，下一節會更詳細地學。

cues.en: Now there are several proofs for why this rule is true, and I'm not going to prove that this rule is true in this video.
cues.zh: 為什麼法則成立，有好幾種證明，但這支影片我不打算證明。

cues.en: And that's because all the proofs basically rely on material I haven't yet told you about.
cues.zh: 因為所有證明，基本上都會用到我還沒教過的內容。

cues.en: So there are several proofs.
cues.zh: 所以有幾種證明。

cues.en: And actually my favorite proof for this also shows that this rule holds for fractional exponents.
cues.zh: 我最喜歡的證明，也能說明這個法則適用於分數指數。

cues.en: So if our is three fourths, not only that it works for integers, that proof is simple and elegant.
cues.zh: 所以 r 可以是四分之三，而不只適用於整數。那個證明簡單又優雅。

cues.en: It's really a beautiful proof, but you can only understand that proof.
cues.zh: 真的是個漂亮的證明，但你只能在

cues.en: After learning about the derivatives of logs and a technique called implicit differentiation.
cues.zh: 學過對數的導數，以及隱微分這個技巧之後，才看得懂。

cues.en: So I promise I am going to show you the proof of this rule in the next section.
cues.zh: 所以我保證，下一節會展示證明。

cues.en: But it's so important and it's so easy to remember that you really just need to memorize this rule here.
cues.zh: 但這個法則很重要，也很好記，你真的需要直接背下來。

cues.en: And, you know, the truth is that everyone memorizes this rule and very, very few people actually memorize the proof that shows that this rule is true.

cues.en: One more thing that I want to cover in this video, which is a pretty neat property of polynomials,
cues.zh: 這支影片還想介紹一點，是多項式很有趣的性質，

cues.en: and that is that the derivative of an even polynomial is odd, is an odd polynomial, and the derivative of an odd polynomial is an even polynomial.
cues.zh: 偶多項式的導數是奇多項式，而奇多項式的導數是偶多項式。

cues.en: Now, why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, actually, it just comes right out of the rule for polynomial derivatives.
cues.zh: 其實直接從多項式導數法則就能得知。

cues.en: Each exponent gets knocked down by one, and so the even numbers turn into odd numbers, and the odd numbers turn into even numbers.
cues.zh: 每個指數都減 1，所以偶數變奇數，奇數變偶數。

cues.en: So let's see what this property means graphically.
cues.zh: 看看這個性質在圖上代表什麼。

cues.en: Here on the top row, you see polynomial functions of different orders.
cues.zh: 上面一列，是不同次數的多項式函數。

cues.en: And then here on the bottom row are their derivatives.
cues.zh: 下面一列是它們的導數。

cues.en: So polynomials to even powers slope down for negative x and slope up for positive X that you see for x squared and x to the fourth.
cues.zh: 偶數次方的多項式，在 x 為負時往下，x 為正時往上，x 平方和 x 四次方都看得到。

cues.en: So that means that their derivatives are negative and then positive.
cues.zh: 表示導數先為負、再為正。

cues.en: And here you see negative and positive.
cues.zh: 這裡就看得到負的與正的。

cues.en: Of course this is the case for a polynomial with a positive coefficient.
cues.zh: 當然，這是係數為正的多項式。

cues.en: If this were minus x squared, then the function would look exactly the same.
cues.zh: 如果是負 x 平方，函數會長得完全一樣，

cues.en: It would just be mirrored here.
cues.zh: 只是像這樣鏡射。

cues.en: And that would mean that we would have a derivative of minus two x, so that would be also the same function just flipped over this way.
cues.zh: 這表示導數會是負 2x，所以也是相同函數，只是往這個方向翻轉。

cues.en: Okay, so that's even polynomials.
cues.zh: 好，這就是偶多項式。

cues.en: Odd ordered polynomials.
cues.zh: 奇數次的多項式，

cues.en: They always go up so that you see here and here as well.
cues.zh: 永遠往上，這裡和這裡都看得到。

cues.en: So they are always increasing the function.
cues.zh: 所以永遠在增加。函數

cues.en: Values can be negative, but the functions are always increasing and therefore their derivatives are
cues.zh: 值可以為負，但函數一直增加，因此導數

cues.en: always positive or more technically non zero because are non negative because there's a zero.
cues.zh: 永遠為正，更精確說非零……是非負，因為有一個零，

cues.en: Exactly at x equals zero.
cues.zh: 恰好在 x 等於零的位置。

cues.en: But certainly there are always going to be positive everywhere else.
cues.zh: 不過其他地方確實永遠為正。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That's it for this video I showed you how to take the derivative of a polynomial expression.
cues.zh: 這支影片就到這裡，我展示了如何對多項式求導數。

cues.en: The most important thing to remember and actually to memorize, you really need to memorize this rule
cues.zh: 最重要的，而且確實要背起來，你真的必須記住的法則，

cues.en: is that the derivative of x to the power of R is are times X to the power of R minus one.
cues.zh: 就是 x 的 r 次方之導數，是 r 乘 x 的 r 減 1 次方。

cues.en: Again, I didn't prove that this rule is correct in this video.
cues.zh: 再提醒，這支影片沒有證明這個法則正確。

cues.en: I'm going to do that in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節我會證明。
